get_avatar.description: Get a Minecraft player's face as a flat, square picture, from their username or UUID, at the size you choose. Ready to use as a profile picture in chat, on a website or in an email, or to save as a file. No API key required.
get_avatar.name: get_avatar

parameters.description: The player's Minecraft username, like jeb_, or their UUID, like 853c80ef-3c37-49fd-aa49-938b674adae6. Usernames aren't case-sensitive.
parameters.name: player

parameters.description: How wide and tall the face is, from 1 to 512 pixels. 160 by default.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: On by default, so the player looks the way they do in the game. Turn it off to show the base skin without hats, hair, jackets or other outer-layer details.
parameters.name: overlay

parameters.description: Which default skin to draw when the player's own skin can't be loaded. By default, the one Minecraft itself would give this player.
parameters.display_name: If the skin can't be loaded, show
parameters.name: default_skin

parameters.description: Off by default, because the link is all a chat message, an email or a web page needs. Turn it on when a later step needs the file itself: attaching it to an email, uploading it to storage, or posting it as a file.
parameters.display_name: Also save the picture as a file
parameters.name: save_as_file

content_type.description: The saved file's type (image/png), or '' when not saved.

document_ref.description: The saved file's document reference, or '' when not saved.

documents.description: The saved picture as a document, ready to attach to a later step. Empty when it was not saved.

url.description: A URL that serves the stored file.

file_size_bytes.description: The saved file's size in bytes, or 0 when not saved.

file_url.description: A URL that serves the saved file, or '' when not saved.

image_tag.description: The same link as an HTML tag, with alt text and size, for a step that writes an email or a page.

player.description: The player the picture is of.

name.description: The player's Minecraft username, spelled the way Minecraft spells it, e.g. 'jeb_'.

uuid.description: The player's permanent Minecraft id (UUID), 32 characters with no dashes, e.g. '853c80ef3c3749fdaa49938b674adae6'. It stays the same when they change their name.

saved_as_file.description: True when the picture was also saved as a file (Also save the picture as a file). The file fields below are empty otherwise.

shows_default_skin.description: True when Crafatar couldn't load the player's own skin just now and drew the default skin (Steve or Alex) instead. Usually temporary: try again later for the real skin.

url.description: A link to the picture on Crafatar, as a PNG. It can go straight into a chat message, an email or a web page, and always shows the player's current skin.

get_body_render.description: Get a 3D picture of a Minecraft player's whole character, head to feet, from their username or UUID. Choose how big to draw it, and save it as a file if you want. No API key required.

look_up_player.description: Find a Minecraft player by username or UUID and get their exact name, their permanent UUID, and links to their face, 3D head and body renders, skin and cape. No API key required.
look_up_player.name: look_up_player

parameters.description: The player's Minecraft username, like jeb_, or their UUID, like 853c80ef-3c37-49fd-aa49-938b674adae6. Usernames aren't case-sensitive.
parameters.name: player

body_render_url.description: A link to a 3D render of their body.

cape_url.description: A link to their cape. It shows nothing when they have no cape; use Get a player's cape to check.

face_url.description: A link to the player's face, 160 pixels.

head_render_url.description: A link to a 3D render of their head.

name.description: The player's Minecraft username, spelled the way Minecraft spells it, e.g. 'jeb_'.

skin_url.description: A link to their skin file.

uuid.description: The player's permanent Minecraft id (UUID), 32 characters with no dashes, e.g. '853c80ef3c3749fdaa49938b674adae6'. It stays the same when they change their name.

uuid_dashed.description: The same UUID with dashes, the way most Minecraft tools show it, e.g. '853c80ef-3c37-49fd-aa49-938b674adae6'.

description: Get Minecraft players' faces, 3D head and body renders, skins and capes from Crafatar, by username or UUID. Every picture comes with a link ready for a chat message, a website or an email, and can be saved as a file to attach. No account or API key required.
